commands.review_summary:
The PR changes SecretRef startup resolution so missing optional built-in TTS provider API keys degrade instead of failing Gateway startup, with docs and regression coverage.

PR surface: Source +132, Tests +386, Docs +8. Total +526 across 13 files.

Reproducibility: yes. source-level reproduction is high confidence: current main collects TTS provider `apiKey` SecretRefs into the runtime snapshot and resolves all collected refs as required startup secrets. I did not run a failing current-main Gateway instance in this read-only review.
commands.review_followup: - [P2] A narrow mechanical repair can align the docs and test expectations with the actual degraded TTS error, while maintainers still retain final review of the SecretRef startup boundary.
